result.summary: Page has no critical breakage but found 3 minor visual issues: truncated restaurant name, inconsistent time badge formatting, and inconsistent favorite icon contrast.

issues.description: Third card in 'Fastest near you' shows restaurant name truncated as 'Trattoria Piccol' cut off at screen edge without ellipsis
issues.suggestion: Ensure carousel cards have consistent width, end padding, and use text-overflow ellipsis for long restaurant names

issues.description: Delivery time badges use inconsistent formatting: '15-25 min' and '20-30 min' without spaces vs '20-30 min' with spaces around hyphen
issues.suggestion: Standardize all time badges to a single format with consistent spacing

issues.description: Favorite heart icon on 'Tokumaru Ramen Bar' card lacks a dark circular background/scrim and has low contrast against the image, while the pizza card below uses a dark circle background
issues.suggestion: Apply a consistent dark translucent circle/scrim behind all favorite icons to ensure visibility and contrast
